sources.title: OlmoEarth open models
sources.snippet: OlmoEarth Engine (rslearn) A tool for developing remote sensing datasets and models. You define spatiotemporal windows, boxes in space and time, and add your training labels to them. rslearn pulls matching imagery, fine-tunes a model on it, and applies it to new places and dates.

sources.snippet: Earth observation data presents a unique challenge: it is spatial like images, sequential like video or text, and highly multimodal. We present OlmoEarth: a multimodal, spatio-temporal foundation model that employs a novel self-supervised learning formulation, masking strategy, and loss all designed for the Earth observation domain.
